# printenv

Print environment values for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/printenv@0.2.4 [-0] [NAME...]
```

## Supported scope

Print all environment entries, or values for the named variables in operand order. Missing requested variables cause status 1.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-0` / `--null` | none | End values with NUL instead of newline. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Limitations

- Full environment listing order is unspecified.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/printenv@0.2.4 PATH
moonx cli/printenv@0.2.4 HOME PATH
```
